Ultra-premium cinematic macro product photograph: a single matte-black USB-C contactless hardware security key FULLY plugged into and seated in the side USB-C port of a dark charcoal-slate laptop. VIEW: {view}. Preserve the EXACT object shown in the first three reference images (the catalogue plates) — do not restyle, recolour, or change its geometry: matte-black glass-fibre-nylon body, ONE brushed-brass NFC disc with a three-arc contactless wave centred on the face, a single debossed PRIMIDS brand icon (the X glyph shown in the LAST reference image, molded tone-on-tone black, graphic only, NO lettering), nickel-steel USB-C connector, molded oval keyring through-slot. The FOURTH reference image defines ONLY the mood, camera angle, composition and depth of field — do NOT copy its navy-blue body colour or its gold disc position; the device must stay matte black with the brass disc per the plates. Lighting: moody near-black scene #0a0a0b, low-key cinematic; the key accent is BRAND ORANGE #FA582E — a crisp #FA582E rim light raking the top edge of the key and the laptop edge, and a soft deep #FA582E radial glow bleeding from behind the port area; faint neutral fill so the brass disc reads warm and brushed. Shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus locked on the NFC disc and the debossed marks, laptop falling into creamy bokeh. ONLY the key and the laptop exist in the frame — no second device, no other objects, no props, no hands, no cables, no screen glow, no text overlays. CRITICAL: the body is a razor-thin flat slab only 3.35 mm thick against 44.8 mm length — elegant and blade-like, NOT chunky or wedge-shaped.
